thread:
devon: opened a focused docs PR to clarify quota header differences across Hosted/Dedicated/Private. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4332
maya: thanks. this is helpful. can we add a short migration snippet for Dedicated customers showing the old header and the new `x-redwood-quota` header mapping?
devon: added snippet: ```bash
# old: X-Rate-Limit: tenant=acme;limit=1000
# new: x-redwood-quota: tenant=acme;tier=standard;burst=100
curl -H "x-redwood-quota: tenant=acme;tier=standard;burst=100" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
kevin: please also call out that Dedicated proxies may strip unknown headers  customers should configure the proxy to forward `x-redwood-quota`.
anna: the docs assets directory needs a different filename for the screenshot or CI will reuse old caches. devon can you add a date suffix?
devon: done — uploaded `assets/metering-panel-20260320.png`. updated the PR.
docs-bot: CI: link check passed, spellcheck warning for 'quotaing' (did you mean 'quoting'?).
maya: corrected wording to 'quotaing' -> 'quotaing' is actually a term we use internally, but product prefers 'quota management'. changed to 'quota management' everywhere.
kevin: nit: unit in the dashboard json should be `tokens/minute` not `tokens/min` per best practice in docs.
devon: changed to `tokens/minute` and updated the example JSON.
maya: approve. would be good to add a short note under "Quota headers" about fallbacks — if `x-redwood-quota` is absent we use tenant defaults and apply tier-based soft limits.
devon: added note and a tiny test snippet showing fallback behavior. merging in 5.
docs-bot: merged branch docs/quota-headers-migration into main (CI #1130)
kevin: can you follow up with a separate PR that updates the Node SDK sample as well?
devon: opened follow-up PR for Node snippet: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4333 — includes an example for express proxy forwarding headers.
anna: thanks for the quick turnaround everyone.
